SELECT 
    "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."DDATE", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."LTR1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."FAT1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."SNF1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."RATE1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."AMT1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."LTR2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."FAT2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."SNF2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."RATE2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."AMT2", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."NFORTNO", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DSTART_DATE", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DEND_DATE", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."VYEAR_CODE"
FROM
    "BGK"."VW_SHIV_DETAIL2" "MILK_BILL_DETAIL",
    "BGK"."MILK_FORTNIGHT" "MILK_FORTNIGHT"
WHERE
    "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NFORTNO" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."NFORTNO" AND
    "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."VYEAR_CODE" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."VYEAR_CODE"
ORDER BY
    "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."VYEAR_CODE" ASC,
    "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."NFORTNO" ASC
